༄༅/ /byang gter gnod sbyin nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi chu sbyin 'bul ba'i cho ga bsam 'phel nor bu'i chu rgyun bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: #!"#༄༅// byang gter gnod sbyin nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi chu sbyin 'bul ba'i cho ga bsam 'phel nor bu'i chu rgyun bzhugs//

na mo gu ru ārya dzambha lā ya/ tshogs gnyis dge ba'i sprin chen las// phan bde'i 'dod dgu'i gru char gyis// skal bzang yid kyi gdung sel ba'i// 'phags pa mchog gis dge legs stsol// de la 'dir gnod sbyin nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi chu sbyin 'bul bar 'dod pas/ stegs gtsang mar chu sbyin dang*/ gtor snod kyi zangs gzhong so sor bshams pa'i dang por sku gzugs dang*/ gnyis par gtor ma/ nye logs su chu bum sogs dgos chas rnams tshogs par byas/ thog mar skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ hūm̐: skye med rnam dag chos dbyings las// mdun du rin chen gzhal med khang*// mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs lte ba la// padma nyi ma zla ba dang: gter gyi bum pa'i khri steng du: hūm̐ las mgon po dzambha la: mthing nag thod khrag ne'u le bsnams: de yi phyi rim pad 'dab bzhi: de steng padma zla ba'i gdan: dzaṃ yig rigs bzhi'i 'phro 'du las: shar du 'phags pa dzambha la: dkar po bgrang phreng ne'u le bsnams: lho ru yon tan dzambha la: gser mdog nor bu shing thog bsnams: nub tu gsung mchog dzambha la: dmar po nor bu ne'u le bsnams: byang du phrin las dzambha la: ljang gu rgyal mtshan ne'u le bsnams: de yi phyi rim pad 'khor brgyad: de steng padma zla ba'i steng: dzaṃ brgyad baṃ brgyad 'phro 'du las: gang bzang la sogs yab brgyad dang: nor rgyun la sogs yum brgyad ni: kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: nor bu dang ni ne'u le 'dzin: kun kyang sku mdog gser gyi mdog: sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs kyi: nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes: de yi phyi rol gru chad la: gnod sbyin a par tsi ta ni: dkar po phyag gnyis bum pa bsnams: pus gtsug bum pa'i gdan la bzhugs: las mkhan tri 'u dam tshig can: byis pa gzhon nu'i cha lugs can: phyag na snying dang zhags pa bsnams:

bar 'khyam gnod sbyin bye ba gnas: sgo bzhi sgo ma bzhi yis srung: de rnams kun gyi gnas gsum las// 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gyur// hūm̐: chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i pho brang nas: longs spyod rin chen sna bzhi'i gzhal yas nas: dgos 'dod dngos grub sna tshogs blang ba'i phyir: mgon po chu dbang 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: e hya hi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdza: hūm̐: gnod sbyin ded dpon mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso: khyod kyis sngon gyi thugs dam brtser dgongs la: sgrub mchog bdag cag re ba bskang ba'i phyir: yid 'ong gnas 'dir dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: sa ma ya: ā be sha ya a ā: hūm̐: gnod sbyin ded dpon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: nyi zla ltar brjid rin chen 'bar ba'i sku: dngos grub sna tshogs zad med mnga' mdzad pa: gter skyong 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: de nas 'bru gsum gyis brlabs pa'i chu gtsang dal bus sbreng la/ yan lag brgyad ldan lha yi gaṅga'i rgyun// zag med 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i zhal skyems 'dis// rab 'byams nor lha'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur nas// bdag la longs spyod 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ dzambha la dza lend+ra ya: bā su dhā ri ṇī swā hā: zhes brgya rtsa brgyad sogs kyis 'bul/ mthar gtor ma 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ snying po la/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi/ btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ hrī: dri med yid 'ong gtsang mar sbyar ba yi: mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dang: dri chab zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: bdud rtsi sman dang rakta bha liṃ brgyan: rin chen sna bdun bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ma hā sarba pū tsa khā hi: zhes sam bsdu na arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/

hūm̐: dngos grub char 'beb rin chen lta bu'i sku: nam mkha'i mdog can thod khrag ne'u le 'dzin: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i: sku mchog 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: yid bzhin rin chen gter gyi char 'beb cing: gangs ri'i mdog can bgrang phreng ne'u le bsnams: dbul phongs sdug bsngal skyob par zhal bzhes pa'i: thugs rjes nyams thag skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dgos 'dod kun 'byung dpag bsam shing lta bu: gser gyi mdog can shing thog ne'u le bsnams: utpal sngon po'i phreng bas sku la brgyan: yon tan longs spyod rgyas la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bsam 'grub re skong nor bu bsam 'phel ltar: dmar gsal rab brjid nor bu ne'u le 'dzin: yid bzhin nor bu'i dngos grub char ltar 'beb: thams cad dbang sdud padma'i gsung la bstod: hūm̐: phrin las lhun grub dngos grub kun gyi mdzod: iṇḍa'i mdog can rgyal mtshan ne'u le bsnams: gang 'dul der ston thabs kyi 'gro don mdzad: phrin las 'gro ba 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sku yi sprul pa gang bzang dpal dang ldan: gsung gi sprul pa nor bzang tshangs pa'i gsung: thugs kyi sprul pa gnod sbyin rig par ldan: phrin las sprul pa rnam thos drag rtsal ldan: zhi ba'i las mdzad pra sna pra dug can: rgyas pa'i las mdzad bzhad gdang phreng ba can: dbang gi las mdzad kha yi dbang po can: drag po'i las mdzad dbang po mchog spyod pa: rin chen gter 'chang dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i mchog: bka' yi bstan skyong dngos grub mchog rnams stsol: mgon po gnod sbyin brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dgos 'dod nor gyi char 'beb nor rgyun ma: shes rab rnam dag ldan pa'i zla 'od ma: dgos 'dod re ba skong ba'i sbyin mar grags: 'phags pa'i nor bdun rab ldan rab sbyin ma: 'khor ba'i sa la skyon bral 'phags mar grags: las rab don grub rab tu bzang mo'i sku:

chos nyid gter 'chang sbas ma'i ngang nyid las: mdzes ma'i skur ston lha mo rab tu gsal: tshangs pa'i gsung mnga' lha mo dbyangs can ma: rin chen rgyan spras mnyes mdzad lha mo brgyad: dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gtso bo'i thugs dam bskul: mkha' dbyings shes rab yum gyi ngang tshul can: nor gter lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: gter bdag chen po a par tsi ta dang: myur mgyogs las mkhan tri 'u thugs dam can: gnod sbyin las mkhan bye ba sa ya'i tshogs: sgo bzhi srung mdzad nor gter lha mo bzhi: kun kyang phyag gnyis nor bu ne'u le bsnams: nor lha yongs rdzogs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'dir byon phul ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes sam/ bsdu na/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing: gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje: byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzaṃ bha la: dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod/ yig brgyad dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ hūm̐: gnod sbyin gter skyong 'khor dang bcas rnams ni: sems can don mdzad byang chub sems dang ldan: dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dpag bsam shing lta bu: yid bzhin rin chen lta bu'i dngos grub stsol: ces pa tsam mam spro na yongs rdzogs kyi mthar snying po'i mjug tu sarba siddhi hūm̐ ā: btags pa brjod la dngos grub kyi chu la longs spyod/ rten yod na ye shes pa/ dzaṃ: gnod sbyin gter skyong 'khor bcas rnams: 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu: 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang: nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang: mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes brtan par bzhugs/ rten med na/ badzra muḥ sa dam ye dbyer med ngang la bstim/ gshegs gsol byar mi rung ngo*// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag: 'phags pa 'khor bcas 'grub gyur nas:

'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa: de yi sa la 'khod par shog: nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing: gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje: byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzambha la: dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa'i bkra shis shog: ces sogs bsngo smon bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// rgyal kun yon tan phung po gcig bsdus dpyid// sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'khor bcas mnyes byed tshul// bsam kun 'phel byed nor bu'i chu rgyun 'dis// skal bzang skye bo'i tshogs kyi gdung sel mdzod// 'di ni bod khams spyi la sman pa'i gter// sgrub sde'i bcud phur rang shar cha lag mchog /gter gzhung dgongs pa bla ma'i man ngag gis// bkral las rang bzo'i rnyogs pas bslad pa med// dge 'dis rdzogs ldan dus bzhin snod bcud dpal// rab 'phel bstan dang bstan 'dzin mnga' thang dar// bshad sgrub phrin las zab mos sa gsum khyon// yongs khyab bkra shis snang bas mdzes gyur cig /ces pa'ang rang gzhan la nyer mkho'i bsam pas sngags btsun 'gyur med padma bstan 'dzin zhe chen rgyal tshab rin po che/gyis bris pa maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
